defect.evidence_quote: [A]n arrest is not justified by what the subsequent search discloses. Under our system suspicion is not enough for an officer to lay hands on a citizen.
defect.problem: The case and citation stand, and the holding is supported, but the quoted sentence is not character-faithful to the disclosed lake quote: the lake quote begins "[A]n," while the page quotes "an" without brackets.
defect.proposed_fix: Quote it as "[A]n arrest is not justified by what the subsequent search discloses" or paraphrase the point.

Lake pin-313 supports that corroboration of verifiable details from a reliable detailed tip can furnish probable cause.
Lake record verifies Spinelli v. United States, U.S. Supreme Court, 1969, official/display citation 393 U.S. 410.
Lake pin-415 supports Spinelli's refinement/application of Aguilar; Gates pin-238 supports the later totality replacement.
Lake record verifies Franks v. Delaware, U.S. Supreme Court, 1978, official/display citation 438 U.S. 154.

Lake pins 238 and 238a support totality of the circumstances, fair probability, and abandonment of the rigid Aguilar-Spinelli approach.

Lake pins 248 and 247 support the totality approach to trained dog alerts and reject a rigid field-record checklist.
